test_title: PYST 84: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Jump on the bandwagon

options.text: To join an activity that has become very popular
To take on a task that is very hard
To reach to a decision without any discussion

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"Jump on the bandwagon"** means to start doing something because it has become popular or fashionable. (सभी के साथ में शामिल हो जाना) • **Example:** Many companies are** jumping on the bandwagon** of sustainability to appeal to eco-conscious consumers. • **Option 1:** To join an activity that has become very popular. (किसी गतिविधि में शामिल होना जो बहुत लोकप्रिय हो गई हो) • **Example:** She decided to** jump on the bandwagon** and started using social media for marketing her products. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2:** To support a wrong person (गलत व्यक्ति का समर्थन करना) • **Example:** Unfortunately, he jumped on the wrong bandwagon by supporting the corrupt politician. • **Option 3:** To take on a task that is very hard (कठिन कार्य लेना) • **Example:** Taking on the project alone was like jumping on a bandwagon with no wheels. • **Option 4:** To reach to a decision without any discussion (बिना किसी चर्चा के निर्णय लेना) • **Example:** Jumping on the bandwagon without discussing the pros and cons can lead to poor decisions. 38:Tb54, The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
